findings.title: Domain contains a protected brand name but is not an official domain of that brand
findings.observed: The registrable domain sbi-kyc-update.top contains the token 'sbi' (State Bank of India). The official domains on record are sbi.co.in, onlinesbi.sbi and sbicard.com.
findings.impact: People read the brand name in the address and assume the page belongs to the bank.
findings.recommendation: Reach the bank only through an address you type yourself or its official app.
findings.limitation: Brand tokens are matched against a curated list of 40 brands; short tokens can occur in unrelated names.

findings.title: Page presents itself as State Bank of India on a non-official domain
findings.observed: The page title is 'SBI Online | Complete your KYC' and the page text mentions 'State Bank of India' 4 times, but the page is served from sbi-kyc-update.top.
findings.impact: A page that claims to be a bank while hosted elsewhere is the core pattern of a phishing page.
findings.recommendation: Do not enter any information on this page.
findings.limitation: Text matching cannot see images; a page could imitate a brand visually without naming it.

findings.title: Domain was registered 6 days ago
findings.observed: RDAP reports the domain was registered on 2026-11-02, 6 days before this analysis.
findings.impact: Phishing campaigns typically use domains for days or weeks; established services rarely move logins to brand-new domains.
findings.recommendation: Treat new domains asking for credentials or payments with extra caution.
findings.limitation: New domains are also used by legitimate new businesses. The RDAP answer was cached from an earlier lookup.

findings.title: Page asks for a password and a one-time password on the same form
findings.observed: The final page contains 1 form with a username field, a password field and a 6-digit OTP field. The form submits to sbi-kyc-update.top.
findings.impact: Collecting a password and OTP together lets an attacker log in to the real account in real time.
findings.recommendation: Never type an OTP into a page you reached from a link in a message.
findings.limitation: Only the first page was inspected; later steps of the flow were not followed.

findings.title: Host is listed in the local demo blocklist fixture
findings.observed: The host sbi-kyc-update.top appears in data/demo_blocklist.json, a fixture created for demonstrations.
findings.impact: None in practice: this is not real threat intelligence.
findings.recommendation: Ignore this finding for real decisions; it exists to exercise the dashboard.
findings.limitation: Synthetic fixture for demos and tests. It is excluded from the classification.

findings.title: URL contains account-action keywords
findings.observed: The URL contains the words 'kyc', 'verify' and 'login'.
findings.impact: These words are used to make a link look like a required account step.
findings.recommendation: Be careful with links that urge you to verify or update an account.
findings.limitation: Many legitimate sites use these words; this signal is weak on its own.

findings.title: Domain uses a top-level domain with a high abuse rate
findings.impact: Some cheap TLDs are disproportionately used for abuse, according to published abuse statistics.
findings.recommendation: Combine with other signals; do not judge a site on its TLD alone.

findings.title: TLS certificate was issued 3 days ago
findings.observed: The certificate for sbi-kyc-update.top was issued on 2026-11-05 by R11 (Let's Encrypt).
findings.impact: A fresh certificate on a fresh domain fits a recently created site.
findings.recommendation: A padlock only means the connection is encrypted, not that the site is trustworthy.
findings.limitation: Certificates are renewed every few months on many legitimate sites, so age is a weak signal.

findings.title: Same server address as an earlier High Risk report
findings.observed: The domain resolves to 203.0.113.45, which was also seen in report b7e19d42 (High Risk) on 2026-11-07.
findings.impact: Shared infrastructure suggests the same operator or campaign.
findings.recommendation: Review the related report for further context.
findings.limitation: Shared hosting can place unrelated sites on the same IP address.

findings.title: Domain is not in the Tranco top-1M popularity list
findings.observed: sbi-kyc-update.top is not present in the Tranco list snapshot of 2026-11-01.
findings.impact: Popular, long-standing sites are usually in the list; absence is common for new or niche sites.
findings.limitation: Absence from a popularity list says nothing about safety.

findings.title: Page text uses urgency and account-suspension threats
findings.observed: The language model identified a verbatim warning that the account will be blocked within 24 hours.

evidence.quote: Your YONO account will be blocked within 24 hours

findings.impact: Time pressure pushes people to act before checking.
findings.recommendation: Pause and verify through an official channel before acting on deadlines.
findings.limitation: Language signals are produced by an AI model and are not verified facts; the quote was checked against the page text.

assessment.rule_text: Two or more moderate-strength signals and no strong or authoritative signal; essential checks completed.
rationale: 4 moderate-strength signals: brand name in a non-official domain, brand named on the page, domain registered 6 days ago, password and OTP form.
No strong or authoritative signal: no listing in URLhaus; the CERT Polska list was unavailable.
Synthetic fixture finding intel.demo_blocklist is excluded from the classification.
contradictions: The certificate chain is valid and the hostname matches. This is expected for phishing sites using free certificates and is not evidence of legitimacy.

ai.summary: This link imitates State Bank of India. The address contains 'sbi' but is not an official SBI domain, the domain is 6 days old, and the page asks for a username, password and OTP together. These are the usual signs of a KYC-update phishing page.

points.explanation: The site uses SBI's name in both its address and its page title, but sbi-kyc-update.top is not one of SBI's official domains.
The domain was registered 6 days ago and its certificate issued 3 days ago. Banks do not move customer logins to brand-new domains.
Asking for a password and a one-time password on one form would let someone log in to the real account immediately.
The same server hosted an earlier High Risk report, and the page pressures visitors with a 24-hour blocking threat.

observations.quote: Your YONO account will be blocked within 24 hours
observations.rationale: Creates time pressure so the visitor acts before checking.

observations.quote: As per RBI guidelines KYC must be updated immediately
observations.rationale: Invokes the regulator to make the request look mandatory.

recommended_actions: Do not enter any details on this page.
If you already entered details, contact your bank using the number on your card or passbook and ask them to block access.
Report the link at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
ai.uncertainty: The page was observed once from one network location; it may show different content to other visitors. A missing threat-intelligence listing does not mean the site is safe.
validation_notes: Removed 1 point that cited an unknown finding id (web.hidden_iframe).
Observation 2: quote not found verbatim in the page text; marked unverified.

recommended_actions: Do not enter credentials, OTPs or card details on this site.
Reach SBI only through an address you type yourself (sbi.co.in or onlinesbi.sbi) or the official app.
If you already entered details: contact your bank through its official number, change your password from the official site, and report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
limitations: Page content was observed once from a single network location; cloaked sites can show different content to other visitors.
The CERT Polska warning list was unavailable for this analysis.
Visual (screenshot) similarity comparison is not implemented.
No automated check can prove a site or message is safe.
